verdict.rationale: AMD's own ROCm documentation describes an open-source stack that supports Linux and lists the MI325X as a supported part (CDNA3/gfx942). AMD also publishes an MI325X system acceptance guide, AMD SMI driver management, and Kubernetes and container tooling that implies Linux deployment. However, the pack contains no explicit Linux driver release notes and no independent hands-on Linux testing of this part. Community comments only question whether the software stack works, which does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver release history or notes specific to MI325X, independent or third-party Linux testing of MI325X.
